fields.heading: From brief to shortlist in minutes.
fields.subheading: Brands define the campaign and ideal audience. The Fanbased system scores, matches and ranks artists using verified fanbase data and our artist vibe analysis.

items.title: Set the brief
items.body: Upload the target demographic, regions, market positioning, partnership details and brand aesthetic.

items.title: We score the overlap
items.body: Our system sifts through audience metrics, and across dimensions like interests and emotional tone.

items.title: Get a ranked shortlist
items.body: We deliver a shortlist of the most aligned matches, with a score and the reasons behind it.

fields.tones: Confident, Refined, Creative, Understated, Culturally relevant

fields.heading: Beyond demographics. We match on meaning.
fields.bodyOne: Demographic overlap isn't enough if the brand clashes with the artist's identity.
fields.bodyTwo: For all brand and product briefs - from lifestyle brands to beverages, from tech companies to fashion collabs - Fanbased evaluates qualitative signals such as vibe, emotional tone, and cultural alignment, and combines these inputs with fan data to create more successful matches.
